title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: The AL Table Proxy Generator is distributed in the Microsoft.Dynamics.BusinessCentral.Development.Tools.Altpgen NuGet package (altpgen.exe missing from AL Language extension)
summary: The AL Table Proxy Generator tool (altpgen.exe) is now distributed through the Microsoft.Dynamics.BusinessCentral.Development.Tools.Altpgen NuGet package instead of the AL Language extension, with support for .NET versions 8.0 and 10.0. The tool generates proxy tables for integrating Microsoft Dataverse tables into Business Central.
key_points: AL Table Proxy Generator moved from the AL Language extension to the Microsoft.Dynamics.BusinessCentral.Development.Tools.Altpgen NuGet package as the official distribution method.
Tool supports multiple .NET versions (net8.0 and net10.0); users select the altpgen.exe matching their installed .NET version.
Azure app registration must be configured as multi-tenant to authenticate with Dataverse; Dataverse table names are case-sensitive.
Proxy tables act as integration connectors linking Business Central tables to Microsoft Dataverse columns, enabling cross-system data integration.

quotes.text: The AL Table Proxy Generator is distributed in the Microsoft.Dynamics.BusinessCentral.Development.Tools.Altpgen NuGet package now.
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates the official shift from bundled extension distribution to centralized NuGet package management for the tool.

quotes.text: The app registered in the Azure Portal must support multi-tenant.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical configuration requirement to successfully authenticate Dataverse connections from altpgen.
